name: When should I consider repairing water damaged window trim instead of replacing it?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider repairing water damaged window trim instead of replacing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing water damaged window trim is usually appropriate when the damage is localized and hasn't compromised the entire trim piece or the surrounding wall structure. If only a small section is soft or discolored, a repair can be a cost-effective solution. However, if the damage is widespread, extends into the window frame, or if there's evidence of mold or rot, full replacement is often necessary to ensure long-term integrity and prevent recurrence. We can assess the extent of the damage during an inspection in your Garden City or Kuna home to help you decide.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider repair for localized damage; replacement is better for widespread issues or structural compromise.
